summary: 3D hot-air balloon wind puzzle over Cappadocia at sunrise, v2 with a pilot balloon, gust telegraph and dawn mass launch, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Gün doğumunda Kapadokya'da 3D sıcak hava balonu rüzgâr bulmacası, v2'de pibal, ani esinti göstergesi ve toplu kalkış, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: No rudder: burn to climb, vent to sink, and ride the wind layer that blows towards the goal
v2: press B to send up a pilot balloon (pibal) that reveals the hidden upper wind layers; gust wedges, windsocks and a rumble warn of strong gusts
v2: a dawn mass launch of 12 balloons on the field, banded tuff strata on the valley walls, a Valley Notebook of six fact cards and a date-seeded Daily Flight
12 flights in 3 regions (Göreme, Uçhisar, an Ihlara-like canyon) with five goal types and 36 stars; the lagging balloon needs early burns and limited propane
The ?auto bot flew 12/12 flights with 36/36 stars using only burner, vent, photo and drop; one index.html, everything generated in code
